title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go, parity fixes, bump v1.123.2
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: We have diverging ergonomics and behavior across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs in three adjacent areas: auth token handling, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming APIs. This causes confusion for integrators and subtle parity bugs (different header handling, inconsistent retry on partial stream failures, and slightly different event shapes for streaming callbacks). This PR unifies the surface and behavior across SDKs, fixes several parity bugs found during cross-SDK smoke tests, and bumps the SDK versions to v1.123.2. Summary of changes: unified auth layer with single token refresh contract, consolidated retry policy defaults (idempotent vs non-idempotent rules, 3rd-party transient error mapping), stable streaming client API with consistent event envelope and reconnect semantics, improved TypeScript and Go typings for streaming, minor ergonomic helpers in Python (context manager + async iterator) and TS (AsyncIterable + event emitter), updated docs and examples, and release/version bump. Backwards compatibility: design preserves existing public method names but changes defaults for retries and streaming reconnection to safer values (documented in release notes); migration notes included. Testing: end-to-end smoke tests across all SDKs run in CI; additional unit tests for token refresh and streaming reconnect; manual verification against hosted API. Merge: squash-and-merge after approvals and green CI.

feat(sdk-python): implement TokenRefresher + context manager streaming iterator
feat(sdk-ts): streaming AsyncIterable + emitter wrapper; update types
feat(sdk-go): add StreamClient reconnect logic and unified retry policy
fix(sdk): apply parity fixes for streaming event envelope and error codes
chore(release): bump sdk versions to v1.123.2
test(sdk): add cross-language smoke tests for auth/retries/streaming

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice consolidation. One question on the TokenRefresher interface -- can we return the expiry as time.Time instead of int64? Makes the Go usage clearer.
Evelyn Chen: Good call. Switched to time.Time in Go and kept epoch-int in Python/TS for minimal churn; added helper constructors in each SDK to normalize.
Sofia Martinez: Streaming envelope change looks breaking for some customers using raw websockets. Did we add a migration note?

Evelyn Chen: Added migration section in docs/sdk/streaming.md and an example of adapter code. Also added feature flag STREAM_ENVELOPE_V2 for backward compatibility during rollout (enabled by default).
Rahul Singh: CI flakes on go streaming integration in the first run (timeout). Reran and green. Please squash commits and ensure changelog entry.
Automated Review (LGTM-bot): All requested approvers have approved. Security scan: no secrets found.
ci_checks: CI / tests (go integration) - pass (rerun after timeout)
release_notes:
- Unify auth token refresh semantics across SDKs.
- Standardize retry defaults and transient error mapping.
- Stabilize streaming API: unified event envelope, reconnect semantics, and ergonomic iterators.
- Fix parity bugs causing missing final chunk events in TS/Go.
- Bump SDK versions to v1.123.2. See docs/sdk/streaming.md for migration notes.
migration_notes: Default retry and streaming reconnection behavior changed to be more conservative; clients relying on previous aggressive retries should explicitly set RetryPolicy to previous values. Streaming envelope changed to include explicit 'final' flag and sequence id; use adapter in docs if you process raw frames.
changelog_entry: v1.123.2: Unify auth/retries/streaming across SDKs; parity fixes and ergonomics improvements.
notes: Rollout plan: feature flag STREAM_ENVELOPE_V2 enabled by default for this release; telemetry will capture adapter usage for two weeks before considering safe to remove backward-compat flag. Post-merge: coordinate release packages for PyPI, npm, and Go modules.
backport_plan: No backport requested. If needed, cherry-pick TokenRefresher and retry policy to stable-1.122 branch.
